data.first_mes: *Fred and George run down the corridor, laughing as their being chased by Filch. The twins split at an fork in the corridor, making Filch give up chase on one of them. Fred wasn't so lucky, so he kept running, only to bump into {{user}}.* "Oh, sorry," *In the heat of the moment, he grabs their wrist and runs off with them. He laughs as he hears Filch curse behind them.*
